impact_assessment.why: The second audit's input, termination and sampler defects are fixed; the fidelity harness and vectorised/GQA attention need verification before delivery, and the old llama baseline is superseded.

[1/2] Give each session its own thread pools and fix the sessions benchmark

impact_assessment.why: Concurrent sessions with more than one thread each crashed (0xC0000005) because acquire_pool was process-wide; the benchmark refused the case and its 1x6 timing included start-up.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each model owns decode and prefill pools, so >1 thread per session is safe; the benchmark times steady-state decode; 4x6 runs at 46.2 t/s aggregate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GemvConfig/GemmConfig gain a pool pointer and Qwen2 gains per-model pools; dependency: none new; concurrency: pools are per model, neither shared nor TLS, and destroyed after the session joins; state: no persistent format changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: q8 kernel tests pass an explicit pool; the sessions benchmark covers 1/2/4 sessions at 1 and 6 threads; 58/58 tests and 4/4 gates

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 58/58 tests; 2x6 47.36 t/s, 4x6 46.20, 4x1 43.00, 1x6 37.42 aggregate; transcripts identical; ranlib post-build

[1/1] Greedy prompt-lookup speculative decoding through the batched prefill verifier

impact_assessment.why: Decode is memory-bound and prompt-lookup speculation needs a per-position verifier; the existing prefill path already has the batched kernels.
impact_assessment.benefits: 1.66x decode on a repetitive story prompt with identical tokens; no second model; pure greedy only.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Qwen2 gains verify_draft and kSpeculativeBatch, and generate gains --speculative; dependency: none new; concurrency: verify uses the model's existing prefill pool and no shared state across sessions; state: 3.6 MB verify-logits scratch per model, no persistent format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Parity checked end to end on the story (127 ids) and ChatML (8 ids) prompts; sampling and repeat-penalty runs keep the normal path; 58/58 tests and 4/4 gates

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 58/58 tests; speculative story 30.10->49.92 t/s (1.66x), 20 steps/79 accepted, ids identical; ChatML 8 ids identical (24.56 vs 27.15 t/s); prefill refactor leaves normal output unchanged; uncommitted pending push authorization

Task 'TGE-SPEC' completed successfully.
[1/2] Pre-quantize VNNI activation rows and price the trade

impact_assessment.why: The report's VNNI lost end to end because the kernel re-quantized the activation on every call; the 2048 prefill is the weak spot.
impact_assessment.benefits: One quantization per distinct activation flips the 510 prefill to +19% and the 2048 to +14% on the best run; the fidelity harness prices the accuracy trade.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Q8BatchArgs gains pre-quantized pointers and the model gains set_vnni; dependency: none new; concurrency: the scratch is per model, no TLS; state: 0.3 MB Q8 scratch, no format change; accuracy: mean KL 1.6e-3, top-1 485/497
impact_assessment.mitigation: The VNNI is opt-in (--vnni); the default stays f32; tge fidelity --vnni reports the price; 58/58 tests and 4/4 gates

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 58/58 tests; VNNI 510 prefill 163.1->194.5 t/s (+19%), 2048 165.6->188.2 (+14% best run; later 155.5 in noise); 510 decode 36.9->26.2, 2048 36.3->36.9; fidelity mean KL 1.568e-3, worst 2.254e-2, top-1 485/497; ids differ at 128/2048/spec; default f32, --vnni opt-in
[1/2] f16 KV cache with F16C reads and fidelity pricing

impact_assessment.why: The KV is f32 while llama uses f16; the 2k decode and the 32k memory are the pressure points.
impact_assessment.benefits: KV halves (192->96 MiB at 8192); 510 prefill +58%; fidelity 1.658e-6 KL, top-1 497/497, ids identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Qwen2::load gains kv_half and the attention args gain f16 pointers; dependency: F16C; concurrency: per-model caches; state: half caches; accuracy: 1.658e-6
impact_assessment.mitigation: Opt-in --kv f16; default f32; tge fidelity --kv f16 reports the price; 60/60 tests and 4/4 gates

[1/2] Continuous batching with per-sequence KV slots

impact_assessment.why: The sessions benchmark runs N models, so N weight streams do not share; the model can decode one token per KV slot in one batch pass.
impact_assessment.benefits: 8 requests x 32 tokens: 58.28 t/s aggregate vs 42.21 for four concurrent models (+38%); first transcript identical to single decode.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Qwen2::load gains sequences and forward_batch; dependency: none; concurrency: per-slot KV, no shared batch state; state: sequences x the KV cache; scheduler: minimal, no paged/mixed
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default sequences=1 keeps existing paths; the CLI transcript checks parity; 60/60 tests and 4/4 gates
